_meta.note: CURATED SAMPLE DATA for the MVP demo. Verify dates and migration guidance against vendor docs before production use. Schema: packages[] matches SDK deps (empty = any), code_patterns[] are regexes matched against repo source (empty = any).

deprecations.migration: Migrate from stripe.Charge.create to stripe.PaymentIntent.create. Map `source` -> `payment_method`, add `confirm=True`, and handle next_action for 3D Secure. See https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-intents
deprecations.title: Legacy Charges API superseded by PaymentIntents (SCA-ready)

deprecations.migration: Replace the legacy Checkout modal with Checkout Sessions (server-side) or the Payment Element. See https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout
deprecations.title: Legacy Checkout (checkout.stripe.com / StripeCheckout.js) retired

deprecations.migration: Migrate one-time passcode flows from the Authy API to the Twilio Verify API (v2). Verify supports SMS, voice, email, push and TOTP under one API. See https://www.twilio.com/docs/verify
deprecations.title: Twilio Authy API end-of-life — migrate to Verify

deprecations.migration: Programmable Fax reached end of life. Migrate fax workflows to a third-party fax provider or remove the integration. See https://www.twilio.com/en-us/changelog
deprecations.title: Twilio Programmable Fax deprecated

deprecations.migration: New Slack apps should use Socket Mode or the Events API instead of RTM. RTM remains for classic apps but receives no new features. See https://api.slack.com/rtm
deprecations.title: Slack RTM API deprecated for new apps — use Socket Mode / Events API

deprecations.migration: The v2 API is retired. Migrate all calls to v3 endpoints (e.g. /v3/mail/send) and use the current SDKs. See https://docs.sendgrid.com/for-developers/sending-email/api-getting-started
deprecations.title: SendGrid v2 API sunset — migrate to v3

deprecations.migration: Migrate transaction ingestion from /transactions/get to /transactions/sync for incremental updates and better coverage. See https://plaid.com/docs/api/products/transactions/
deprecations.title: Plaid legacy /transactions/get superseded by /transactions/sync
